vulnerable_code:
class UserProfileSerializer < ActiveModel::Serializer
  attributes :id, :username, :email, :role

  # Leaking private session credentials and SSO tokens in public directory serialization
  has_many :auth_tokens
  has_many :sso_identities
end

class Api::V1::UsersController < Api::BaseController
  def show
    user = User.find(params[:id])
    render json: user, serializer: UserProfileSerializer
  end
end
diagnosis: UserProfileSerializer includes auth_tokens and sso_identities associations without checking if the current viewer (scope) is the owner of the user profile. Any registered organization user querying colleagues' directory profiles receives active API session tokens and OAuth refresh secrets, enabling full account takeover.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/users/usr_4821 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.collab-suite.com
Authorization: Bearer org_member_jwt_202
Accept: application/json
corrected_code:
class UserProfileSerializer < ActiveModel::Serializer
  attributes :id, :username, :email, :role

  has_many :auth_tokens, if: :current_user_or_admin?
  has_many :sso_identities, if: :current_user_or_admin?

  def current_user_or_admin?
    scope == object || scope&.admin?
  end
end

class Api::V1::UsersController < Api::BaseController
  def show
    user = User.find(params[:id])
    render json: user, serializer: UserProfileSerializer
  end
end
